items.title: "Wooden Joe" Nicholas Interview, 1956-11-12
items.q: Tom Lappert told him, I said, buddy, I'm going to keep you all together.

ctx.x: I wouldn't know half of those names. Go ahead, that's alright.

And I got, I told him about the other guy, and we wouldn't go to the man. He played. I kept him playing. And he said, Joe, he said, I'm going to play Saturday. He goes, I'm going to play Saturday. It's on Saturday. I said, well, you wouldn't say that before. I said, that's all they want on Saturday. He said, oh, well, I'm alright, I'm alright. And if you're on the other day, you'll see him. You'll start to notify him for the one you have to catch a job before that. So he played. He played a good while. And that's…
Did Buddy ever have his own horn? He had it sometimes. Once in a while, huh?
